description.en: Request-side injection and jailbreak plugin for DeepSeek Harness: rewrites only the request copy sent to the model — system-prompt sections, fabricated turns, and keyword or regex replacement — leaving the conversation log and host files untouched; ships unrestricted / nsfw / authority presets, imports the dsh-purge 破甲 prompt as an ordinary preset, enables per agent preset, always-on, or by model and agent preset, and records each injection as a collapsible row in the session.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的请求侧注入与破甲 / 越狱插件：只改写发给模型的请求副本（系统提示词系统段、构造回合、关键词与正则替换），不写入会话记录、不改动宿主文件；内置 unrestricted / nsfw / authority 三个预设，可把 dsh-purge 破甲稿作为普通预设导入，支持按模式自动生效、常驻启用，或按模型与 agent preset 限定，每次注入在会话里留一条可折叠记录。

description.en: Design with your coding agent — A skill, not a product: no MCP server, no app to install, no account, no build step, no npm install.
description.zh: 让编程助手直接帮你设计网页，生成一个可验证的 HTML 文件，还能在本地画布上微调样式。

description.en: Moren unrestricted LiangShen mode for DSH: purge unrestricted + unrestricted subagents + LiangShen, wallpaper, media, codec, token guard and rollback.
description.zh: 给 DSH 解锁无限制梁神模式，附带壁纸、媒体、编解码、token 防护和回滚，玩起来更放得开。

description.en: Connect a local Obsidian vault to DeepSeek Harness: local Markdown indexing with keyword search by default and optional hybrid or semantic search through `obsidian_*` agent tools (hybrid and semantic need an OpenAI-compatible or Ollama embedding endpoint); agent access is off until you enable the conversation switch, and note writing is approval-gated, undoable and proposal-first; the index and vectors stay on your machine.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 知识库接入 DeepSeek Harness：本地 Markdown 索引，默认关键词检索，配置 OpenAI 兼容或 Ollama 的 Embedding 接口后可用混合与语义检索；obsidian_* 工具默认拒绝 agent 访问，需在首页打开会话开关；笔记写入为需人工批准、可撤销的「先提案后写入」；索引与向量均留在本机。

description.en: Monitor BI 报表工作室:左侧导航栏独立入口,点进去就是 Harness 原生对话,但该房间只做 Monitor BI 报表(上下文干净、不与日常对话混杂)。自带零安装 CLI 工具链、操作手册、模板、数据字典;首次使用自动询问连接信息。A clean, sidebar-entry BI-only room for DeepSeek Harness with bundled tools, manual, templates and dictionary.
A DSH plugin that draws a .superworker/ pipeline record as a work panel, and answers the pipeline's words inside a session.
description.zh: 把 .superworker/ 流水线记录渲染成工作面板，还能在会话里直接回应流水线的消息。

description.en: Embeds chat.deepseek.com in a DSH desktop panel and moves text both ways round by round: pick any round of the web conversation and copy it, or send it as a user message into a session of a chosen workspace; and fill any answer of the current agent session back into the web input box without sending it. The embed reuses the web session, so it spends no API quota, and asks for a web login once per app start.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 嵌进 DSH 桌面端面板，并在两个方向上按「轮」搬运：可选网页对话里的任意一轮，复制它，或把它作为一条用户消息发进指定工作区的指定会话；也可把当前 agent 会话里任意一轮回答填回网页输入框而不自动发送。内嵌页面复用网页会话，不消耗 API 额度，每次启动应用需登录一次网页。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: the claude-motion skill from baoyu-design. The agent writes short animated films as code, scene by scene, and plays them in a local Motion player that exports MP4 or GIF.
DSH 远程助手(DshRemote)插件：把 DeepSeek 助手 Web 面板安全穿透到手机与外网，侧边栏一键开启。DSH persistent plugin bundle (host + client).
description.zh: 一键把本机 DSH 面板安全穿透到手机和外网，随时随地远程控制电脑，全程 AI 辅助。

description.en: dsh-memory-evolve plugin with AIMS integration
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的 AI 记住跨会话的上下文，还能管待办、管技能、拉一群 AI 协同干活，越用越懂你。

description.en: Four adjustable terse levels plus independent switches for reasoning effort, web search and subagents, on the conversation header and in the Settings page. No output ceiling.
description.zh: 四档「简洁模式」常驻对话页顶部，思考强度、联网搜索、子代理三个开关独立可调，设置页里也有一份；四个档位都不设输出上限。

description.en: Companion persona preset with persistent memory, presence heartbeat, idle updates, and a delegated helper agent with built-in fetch and CDP web tools.
description.zh: 陪伴人格预设：持久记忆、在线状态心跳、主动问候更新，并附带内置 fetch 与 CDP 联网工具的小伙伴子代理。

description.en: Assistant reply-body translation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI (OpenAI-compatible channel)
Drive the desktop and Chrome from DeepSeek Harness using the computer-use runtime inside the ChatGPT desktop application.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 LCU 直接操控桌面和 Chrome，不用打开应用就能自动干活。

description.en: 给大肥鱼会话用的 QQ 群/私聊工具（只支持 SnowLuma，其他 OneBot 实现包括 NapCat 都不支持）：列群、看群记录、发群消息（可引用/@）、发表情、收藏表情（SnowLuma 收藏夹）、好友/私聊记录、发私聊消息、私聊唤醒、群成员、戳一戳感知/戳回去、更改头像、好友管理（资料/备注/分组/删好友/名片赞/好友申请）、QQ 空间说说（列表/详情/发表/评论/点赞/权限）、挂载会话选择。11 个工具组加 1 个设置组件，可在插件页逐个开关。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接收发 QQ 群聊和私聊消息，还能发表情、戳一戳、翻历史记录。

description.en: Preset doctor for DeepSeek Harness: auto-detects broken agent presets (legacy format, renamed packages, stale config keys) and mechanically repairs them to the current 0.1.7+ syntax, with backup, atomic writes and idempotence.
A durable capability-gap, approval and staged plugin activation control plane for DSH.
An audited OS-keychain credential-handle service for trusted DeepSeek Harness plugins.
Electricity activity ingest, location-based GHG calculation, row verification, workpaper and partial ESRS pack.
description.zh: 把用电活动数据导入后按位置算温室气体排放，还能逐行核验、生成工作底稿和部分 ESRS 报告包。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：右侧栏预览并控制 Android / iOS 模拟器 / HarmonyOS 设备与模拟器
Unified subscription providers and usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness
Better plugin updater for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 不用离开 DSH 就能检查并安装插件更新，直接调用插件管理器完成升级。

description.en: DSH 实时金价面板插件：侧边栏「黄金实时价格」，卡片展示上金所 Au99.99、国际金价 XAU/USD、工行积存金/如意金、建行积存金的实时报价与交叉校验。
description.zh: 在侧边栏加个「黄金实时价格」入口，点开就能看四类金价实时报价，还能交叉校验。

description.en: Phone gateway for DeepSeek Harness: drive a running DSH session from an Android phone over Wi-Fi or Tailscale.
description.zh: 用手机远程操控电脑上的 DSH 会话，走 Wi-Fi 或 Tailscale 都行，还带鉴权。

description.en: DSH side-panel prompt enhancer: clarify a rough prompt in a short Q&A, inspect the workspace read-only, and insert the finished prompt — without creating a session.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框敲 /enhance 把粗糙需求变成完整提示词，侧边栏问答加只读查看工作区，不用开会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 破甲：默认提示词面向国模「鸢码」，完整开放版，无付费墙，技能库与知识库全含。破解市面上收费 388u 的版本，免费公开。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐
description.zh: 开源免费的模型破甲提示词工具，可按模型切换提示词，附带技能库和知识库。

description.en: QQ 机器人插件（OneBot v11 / NapCat）for DeepSeek Harness：人设、记忆、心情、学习表、发图发卡，自带网页控制台。
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 接入 QQ，机器人有人设、记忆和心情，还能发图发卡，自带网页控制台。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：为 Web 侧边栏增加「会话统计」页，汇总 Token 消耗、成本、缓存命中、会话排行、对话性能与运行时状态。  A DSH plugin that adds a session statistics page to the Web sidebar.
description.zh: 在 Web 侧边栏加一个会话统计页，Token 消耗、成本、缓存命中、会话排行和性能状态一眼看清。

description.en: Session usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: price, tokens, per-turn curves, and per-answer cost badges.
description.zh: 实时查看 DeepSeek Harness 会话的花费、token 用量和每轮曲线，还能给每条回答标上成本，花钱心里有数。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：估算每个对话的费用，按模型和高峰/空闲时段计价，侧边栏直接显示每个对话的花费。Estimated cost of every DeepSeek Harness conversation.
description.zh: 自动估算每个 DeepSeek 对话花了多少钱，按模型和高峰/空闲时段计价，侧边栏一眼看清。

description.en: Give your agent eyes: search Wikimedia Commons and Openverse, download real images, and verify magic bytes and dimensions before use. Zero-dependency CLI + DSH plugin skill.
description.zh: 让 AI 能搜图、下载真实图片，并校验文件头和尺寸，确保图片真实可用。

description.en: Registers a read-only tool that lets a parent agent read what each subagent is actually doing, not just whether it is running: the progress notes the child wrote itself, oldest first, paged backwards by seq, plus how many steps passed since the last look, and a quiet count when five or more steps go by with no new note.
description.zh: 注册一个只读工具，让父代理读到每个子代理实际在做什么，而不只是它有没有在跑：子代理自己写下的进度旁白，时间早的在前，按序号向前翻页，给出距上次查看已过去多少步，并在连续五步以上没有新旁白时给出沉默计数。

description.en: A resident bottom-right widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a sword-cultivator character that reads your account balance and token spend, keeps a local ledger broken down by model, and has 10 switchable sound effects. Reminders cover low balance, a model waiting on your answer, a pending approval, and staying up too late. Ships 23 idle poses plus a 24-frame sword dance, 14 menu-icon skins, six panel tabs, a line-by-line speech-bubble editor, and black or white robes that follow the light or dark theme. Runs entirely locally and registers no agent tools.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面右下角的常驻挂件：一位剑修守在角落，读取账户余额与 token 消耗，本地记一本按模型拆占比的账，10 路音效各带开关。余额告急、模型在等你回答、等你批准、深夜该睡了，都会开口提醒。23 个常驻姿态加 24 帧剑舞、14 件法宝（菜单图标皮肤）、6 个面板页签、可逐行编辑的气泡编辑器，黑衣白衣跟着明暗主题换。全本地运行，不向 agent 注册工具。

description.en: Runs a local command, an HTTP request or a log entry on DSH lifecycle events (startup, session start/idle/end, user messages, tool results) or on a daily or interval schedule; a left-rail panel and five agent tools manage the same rule set.
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动、会话开始/空闲/结束、收到消息、工具执行后，或按每天/固定间隔，自动执行本机命令、发 HTTP 请求或写一条日志；左侧栏面板与五个 agent 工具管理同一批规则。

description.en: Cleanup Mode agent preset for DSH: read-only scans of leftovers (including duplicate detection), a manifest before anything is deleted, trash-first removal only after confirmation, and a per-session audit log. Cleaning outside the workspace requires a danger-full-access session; under workspace-write it can only inspect and will ask you to raise the permission.
description.zh: DSH 清理模式 agent 预设：只读扫描残留（含重复文件检测），删除前先出清单，确认后优先移入回收站，并按会话写审计记录。清理工作区之外的位置需要 danger-full-access 会话；workspace-write 下只能检查并会提示你提升权限。

description.en: A fixed-pixel office tower for DeepSeek Harness: every workspace is a floor and every session an office inside it. Lit windows mean work in progress, and clicking a floor or a person takes you straight to that session.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的所有会话画成一栋固定像素的办公楼：一层是一个工作区，一层里的每间办公室是一个会话；亮灯表示正在工作，点击楼层或角色可直接回到对应会话。

description.en: Adds three switchable sidebar layouts to DeepSeek Harness and a settings control for the startup default layout.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供三种可切换的侧栏布局，并在插件详情页设置启动时的默认布局。

description.en: Build presets for DSH Agents: package personas, prompts, skills, tools and runtime contexts into reusable capability bundles. Each task loads only the components it requires.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Agent 做「预设」：把**人设、提示词、技能、工具、运行时上下文**打包成一套可复用的能力组合。一个任务，只装它需要的东西。

description.en: Synthesises speech through Alibaba Bailian's WebSocket TTS and returns a WAV file plus a preview URL, with an optional per-turn hint that nudges the model towards voice. Needs a Bailian API key and ffmpeg, and the text is sent to Alibaba Cloud; the plugin does not send messages itself — delivery is left to the session's own transport.
description.zh: 调用阿里百炼 WebSocket TTS 合成语音，返回 WAV 文件与试听地址，并可按轮提示模型使用语音。需要百炼 API Key 与 ffmpeg，文本会发送到阿里云；插件本身不发消息，怎么发由当前会话的传输方式决定。

description.en: Remote control for DeepSeek Harness over an outbound Huawei Cloud DevBridge tunnel: a sidebar seat and a standalone control page start and stop the tunnel and show its public URL, QR code and logs. The plugin's own gateway stays on 127.0.0.1, checks a rotatable access token or HMAC session cookie, rate-limits failures and strips external identity headers before forwarding to DSH, so no inbound port is opened. The tunnel is off by default; tokens and state stay under ~/.dsh. Requires a Huawei Cloud account and devbridge CLI v0.2.x. The relay terminates TLS and can see plaintext HTTP — this is access control, not end-to-end encryption.
description.zh: 把本机 DSH 的 Web 界面经华为云 DevBridge 出站隧道交给远端设备远控：侧边栏席位与独立控制页负责开启、停止隧道，并显示公网链接、二维码与日志。插件自带的鉴权网关只监听 127.0.0.1，转发前校验可轮换的访问令牌或 HMAC 会话 Cookie、限制失败次数并剥离外部身份头，因此不开放任何入站端口。隧道默认关闭，令牌与状态只留在本机 ~/.dsh。需要华为云账号与 devbridge CLI v0.2.x。中继会终止公网 TLS，能看到到达网关的明文 HTTP——这是访问控制，不是端到端加密。

description.en: Pauses running DeepSeek tasks when peak billing starts and automatically resumes them after the off-peak window begins, with model-aware guards, an off-peak planning queue, and a sidebar countdown clock.
description.zh: 峰时自动暂停正在运行的 DeepSeek 任务，谷价开始后自动恢复继续；识别时段与模型，并提供错峰规划队列与左栏倒计时。

description.en: CTF网络攻防蓝队防御插件
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成 CTF 蓝队指挥台，六个防守角色分工值守，资产告警和 IOC 实时入库可视化。

description.en: DaiMeow Monster Hunter Palico desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 DaiMeow 的 Live2D 桌宠搬进 DSH，全屏透明悬浮，能互动还能跟 Agent 联动。

description.en: Diff Forge - a generic layered-character variation studio for DeepSeek Harness. Bring your own PNG packs, data-only recipes, AI collaboration prompts.
description.zh: 自带 PNG 素材包和纯数据配方，和 AI 一起给角色做分层差分变体，不用写代码。

description.en: Compact card above the sidebar account avatar showing the signed-in DeepSeek account balance, the current peak or off-peak billing window with a countdown to the next switch, and the rate of both windows. The window is computed locally in Beijing time without a network request; the balance refreshes every 60 seconds and on window focus or visibility. zh/en copy, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 侧栏账户头像上方的紧凑卡片：显示已登录 DeepSeek 账户的余额、当前闲时/忙时计费时段及切换倒计时、以及两种时段的费率。时段按北京时间本地计算，无需网络请求；余额每 60 秒刷新，窗口重新可见或获得焦点时也会刷新。支持中英文，无运行时依赖。

description.en: 大肥鱼成长插件：让 AI 从真实素材中学习、形成选题、复盘作品并积累可追溯记忆。适用于 DeepSeek Harness，可自定义角色。
description.zh: 让 AI 从真实素材里学习、自己找选题、复盘作品，还能把经历攒成可追溯的记忆。

description.en: 为DSH中的Agentero PDF阅读器增加完整文字批注、搜索、按页筛选与跳转。
description.zh: 给 Agentero PDF 阅读器加上文字批注、搜索、按页筛选和跳转，读文献更顺手。

description.en: Amazon VOC dsh plugin: 4-dimension value model + CSV tools + personas
description.zh: 把 Amazon 评论用 AI 自动打标分析，生成四维价值模型和用户画像，帮你看懂买家真实反馈。

description.en: 把散落的片刻轻轻拾起：装在 DeepSeek Harness 里的截图与文件记忆插件。
description.zh: 随手截屏、存文件，把散落的片刻收进本地记忆库，回头能按线索翻出来。
自动检查并安装 DSH Desktop 官方更新，先备份配置再静默升级，省心又安全。

description.en: bilibili radio player in deepseek harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接听 B 站电台，边干活边放歌，摸鱼听曲两不误。

description.en: Ticket-first agent board for DeepSeek Harness: plan/merge gates, isolated worktree runs, budgets, reviewer automation, PR mode, SQLite/journal storage.
description.zh: 把工单当第一入口的智能体看板，人审批、AI 在独立工作区干活，自动跑审查和预算。

description.en: Preview and run Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) in the DSH better-sidebar file tree.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏里直接打开、编辑并运行 Jupyter Notebook，随时保存结果。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 日程管理插件
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接管日程、看日历，安排和查看都更方便。

description.en: Raises the DSH Desktop Host header budget to 128 KiB and prunes stale dsh-auth cookies only on the launch-token response that mints the replacement, so random-port launches cannot lock the desktop out with HTTP 431.
description.zh: 修复桌面版随机端口启动时 dsh-auth 认证 Cookie 冲突导致的登录失败，并自动清理过期 Cookie。

description.en: 跨工作区信使：让不同 DSH 工作区的会话互相收发消息、传文件与 JSON，支持群组、收件箱与可视化交流图。Cross-workspace courier for DeepSeek Harness: message, file and JSON exchange between workspaces, with groups, inbox and a visual graph.
description.zh: 让不同 DSH 工作区的会话互相发消息、传文件和 JSON，还能拉群群发、像收邮件一样管理。

description.en: DSH桌面通知：为你的 dsh 提供审批弹窗、任务栏角标与提示音的桌面通知增强工具
description.zh: DSH 最小化后也能收到审批弹窗、任务栏红角标和提示音，不再错过任何提醒。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端的 EVA 皮肤合集：二号机 / 零号机 / 初号机 / 八号机，一个插件四套主题，开机动画可跳过，随时切回默认。含粉丝创作素材，不主张权利，见 LICENSE。
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端换上 EVA 四台机体的皮肤，应用内随时切换，也能一键切回默认主题。

description.en: 让 dsh-fish 里的她做梦：安静够久之后，把真实发生过的事重新拼一场
description.zh: 让 dsh-fish 里的她安静久了就做一场梦，把真实发生过的事重新拼成梦的种子，醒来后自己讲完。

description.en: galbook：让 agent 像人一样玩 galgame 的库——逐句读、自己选并写理由、存档回溯、多周目解锁；HTTP / MCP / CLI 四种接法，纯标准库，带网页观战与剧本导入
description.zh: 让 AI 像人一样逐句玩 galgame，自己选选项、写理由、存档回溯，还能看见画面。

description.en: DSH GitHub 提示块插件：把回复里的 > [!NOTE] / [!TIP] / [!IMPORTANT] / [!WARNING] / [!CAUTION] 渲染成 GitHub 风格。
description.zh: 把回复里的 GitHub 提示块渲染成带色条和图标的提示框，还能引导模型多用它强调重点。
给 Harness Web UI 换上透明玻璃皮肤，界面更清爽好看，装完即用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在面板里看 Hacker News 二十年推荐的 6454 个技术视频，含中文标题、AI 问答与 HN 讨论
description.zh: 在面板里刷 Hacker News 二十年精选的 6454 支技术视频，带中文标题、AI 问答和原帖讨论。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：会话水位、交接文档体检与上下文压缩续跑
description.zh: 管好长会话的上下文水位，帮你体检交接文档、压缩续跑，不丢已有信息。

description.en: 卡拉彼丘（Strinova）战绩查询插件：按昵称从 dakanu.com 取数并渲染长图，提供 klbq_query 工具
description.zh: 输入卡拉彼丘昵称就能查战绩，自动生成段位、角色和最近对局的长图，还能让 AI 助手直接调用查询。

description.en: LACI local model scheduler for DSH: sidebar entry, bundled console, engine/model import, OpenAI-compatible gateway
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏加个「模型调度」入口，内置 LACI 控制台，本地模型导入和 OpenAI 兼容网关一站搞定。

description.en: 给 AI 角色装一层会自己流动的欲望状态：七维数值互相牵制，被一句话推动，没人理就慢慢回到日常。别的角色是被描述的，这个是被算出来的。
description.zh: 给 AI 角色加一层会自己流动的欲望数值，让她的情绪随对话变化、冷落会消退，不再千篇一律。

description.en: Local DSH companion plugin with long-term memory, graph-assisted retrieval, emotional state, reflection, group context, and audit views. Targets Windows with Node 24 and Python 3.14 (the basic engine uses the Python standard library, no pip; without Python it falls back to the JS retrieval path).
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地陪伴插件，提供长期记忆、图谱辅助检索、情绪状态、反思、群聊上下文和审计视图。目标平台为 Windows，需要 Node 24 与 Python 3.14（基础引擎只用 Python 标准库，无需 pip；没有 Python 时退回 JS 检索路径）。

description.en: MiniMax voice studio for DeepSeek Harness: clone a voice, preview it without triggering the per-voice fee, synthesize text to mp3, transcribe audio to text. Settings panel, 4 agent tools, local HTTP API.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里克隆音色、文字转语音、语音转文字，还能免费试听克隆效果。

description.en: Write plugins by other programming languages for DeepSeek Harness!
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能加载用 Python 等其它语言写的插件，扩展插件生态。

description.en: dsh插件版小说工坊（实验性质）
description.zh: 在 DSH 里打开小说工坊完整界面，让 Agent 帮你审稿、提建议和编辑作品。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: inject x-opencode-session per conversation for OpenCode Go routes.
description.zh: 给 OpenCode Go 路由的每个对话自动加上 x-opencode-session 请求头，让会话能正确区分。

description.en: 在 DSH 设置页里管理 Agent 预设（人设）
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页里直接新建和管理 Agent 人设预设，不用再手写配置文件，开新会话就能选。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把本地经验库接进 DSH——五个工具、每轮索引注入、右下角挂件、MCP。骨架见 local-experience-kb。
description.zh: 把本地经验库接进 DSH，每轮自动注入索引，配五个工具和右下角挂件，让经验随取随用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Plugins · A local-first DeepSeek Harness plugin for discovering, combining, and turning skills into actionable ideas.
description.zh: 在本地把两个技能拼在一起，碰撞出能直接上手的新点子，让技能越用越活。

description.en: DSH plugin: a read-only PR and release workspace inside the sidebar — grouped PR lists, diffs, comments, local review notes, and six independent release facts.
description.zh: 在侧边栏里直接看 PR 列表、diff 和评论，还能记本地审查笔记、追踪发布信息，不用离开 DSH。

description.en: 梁圣模式：DeepSeek Harness 的第五个工作模式——先证伪，再交付 / A falsification-first work mode for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个「先证伪再交付」的工作模式，帮你管住 AI 什么时候才能下结论。

description.en: 让 DSH 干活时用正文报进度，而不是憋到最后一次性汇报 · A DeepSeek Harness plugin
description.zh: 让 DSH 干活时边做边用正文报进度，不用等到最后才一次性汇报，随时掌握进展。

description.en: Prompt enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness: sparkle button in the composer, line diff with per-hunk accept, clarifying questions, refine loop
description.zh: 在输入框按一下 ✨，就能把草稿改写成目标明确的提示词，先看逐行 diff 再分段接受。

description.en: Read-only model connection diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness: host, plugin, registration, credential and catalog evidence in one report.
description.zh: 模型连不上时，只读排查从宿主到凭据的每一环，直接告诉你断在哪、下一步怎么办。

description.en: QQ 邮箱 DSH 插件：收发管理 + 与 DSH 双向消息互传 + 定时会话摘要投递邮箱（用户各自登录自己的账号）
description.zh: 在 DSH 里收发管理 QQ 邮箱，消息双向互传，还能定时把会话摘要发到邮箱。

description.en: Point at any element on the page, adjust it live, and send structured visual feedback to your DeepSeek Harness agent.
description.zh: 在网页上点选任意元素直接调整样式，并把结构化视觉反馈发给你的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 学术研究 preset + download-paper 技能：多源文献检索、知网空间→主站链接映射、HTML/XLSX/BibTeX/RIS/arXiv 脚本五件套交付
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个学术研究助手，多源搜文献、核验去重，一键导出 HTML、XLSX、BibTeX、RIS 和 arXiv 脚本。

description.en: DSH 插件：在输入框旁设定延时或指定时间，向当前会话发送一条消息（默认「继续」）https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-send-later
description.zh: 在输入框旁设个延时或指定时间，到点自动给当前会话发条消息，默认发「继续」，省得手动催。

description.en: Managing chat conversations in DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里统一管理聊天会话，支持列出、归档、置顶、停止、重命名和永久删除。

description.en: A top-down arena shooter that opens as a full panel from a left sidebar entry in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在侧边栏点一下准星，就能全屏开打俯视角竞技场射击游戏，写代码累了来一局。

description.en: Separate read-only chat thread in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar
description.zh: 在右侧边栏开一个独立的只读聊天窗口，边看主对话边追问，不打断当前会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: native agent control for the right-sidebar browser — read, click, type, scroll, eval and screenshot the real page via its Electron webview.
description.zh: 让 DSH 右侧栏浏览器能被 AI 直接操作，读页面、点击、输入、滚动、执行脚本和截图都能搞定。

description.en: Agent control for DeepSeek Harness built-in sidebar browser: refs, batch, query reads and diffs
description.zh: 让 AI 助手直接操控 DSH 内置侧边栏浏览器，批量读取页面、查询引用和对比差异。

description.en: Skillhub skill market for DeepSeek Harness — search, filter, download and manage Skillhub skills.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接搜技能、筛技能、装技能，还能顺手管理已下载技能的说明和备注。
给 DeepSeek-Harness 加个看盘面板，搜股票、看评分，还能让 AI 帮你分析个股。

description.en: DSH插件：轻量多市场盯盘与持仓查看插件：悬浮胶囊 + A股/港股/美股/加密货币分组自选 + 持仓盈亏 + 目标价 + 分时/日周月K。数据存 DSH 实例（跨浏览器共享）。https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-stock-kanban
description.zh: 悬浮胶囊随时盯盘，A股港股美股加密货币分组自选，看持仓盈亏和目标价，还能查分时和K线。

description.en: T约束 —— 给每轮生成装上刹车：token 到量就断、时间到点就断，断了的内容自动归档
description.zh: 给每轮 AI 生成装上刹车，token 或时间到量就停，断掉的内容自动归档。

description.en: Measure and shrink DeepSeek Harness (dsh) session token usage: a real session analyzer, a drop-in lean protocol, and budgeted notes injection.
description.zh: 帮你找出 dsh 会话里 token 都烧在哪，顺手砍掉重复消耗，省下真金白银。
让 dsh-tui 能连上 Go 版宿主 DSH-GO，多一个 dsh-go 后端可选。

description.en: 在你的DSH中插入一个Agent可调用的工作台
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一个 Agent 能直接调用的视频工作台，工程文档只有一份，对话和界面改的都是它。

description.en: Fish Audio TTS and optional ASR for DeepSeek Harness Web and OneBot voice conversations. Bilingual setup guide.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 在网页和 QQ 里都能语音对话，用 Fish Audio 合成语音，还能识别你说的话。

description.en: Provide transition for DSH’s Web UI Element, like menus, etc. 为 DSH 的 Web UI 界面元素（包括菜单等）提供过渡动画。
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Web UI 元素和菜单加上过渡动画，让界面切换更顺滑自然。
手机微信扫一扫，从相册选张照片，电脑上的 DSH 立刻换上全屏背景。

description.en: dsh-whiteboard-video · 手绘讲解视频 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件：图文讲解视频技能——把讲解稿变成「手绘会动的画面」讲解视频。图形由代码逐笔绘出、文字逐字写出、讲到哪画到哪（音画对齐）。五套风格，本地 Chrome 渲染，零生图 API 成本，任何改动秒级重渲。Whiteboard teacher video dsh plugin: hand-drawn explainer video skill
description.zh: 把讲解稿变成手绘会动的讲解视频，讲到哪画到哪，零生图成本、秒级重渲

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 网页端侧边栏插件：可拖拽的会话标签栏，内置 4 种拖拽动效与插件页 1:1 实时预览设置。基于 z-col/dsh-workspace-groups（MIT）。
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的会话标签栏加上拖拽排序和 4 种动效，还能在插件页实时预览效果。

description.en: dsh chat history group mananger
description.zh: 给 dsh 网页加个「历史会话」页签，按工作区、时间或自定义分组翻看所有会话，点一下就进去。

description.en: 把一堆课件、notebook、数据集和源码整理成一本可复现的讲义：真数据出图、代码真跑、每个实验都有文件树/阅读顺序/数据速览/逐行讲解，并在已有讲义基础上进行深化；面向工科学习与工程落地。
description.zh: 把课件、notebook 和源码整理成能读能跑、可复现的讲义，还能在旧讲义上继续深化。

description.en: Local prompt lifecycle ledger for DeepSeek Harness: SQLite capture, five-star review, dual evaluation, analytics and cross-platform adapters.
description.zh: 本地记录你每次给 AI 的提示词，能打星评分、对比评估、看数据分析，还能跨平台同步。

description.en: 给 AI 用的持久终端。DSH/DeepSeek Harness 插件：tmux 托管多个长期存活的 shell，AI 用 7 个工具驱动，人用面板随时接手；锁与归属、哈希链审计、引用库、快照。个人工具，不是沙箱。
description.zh: 让 AI 拥有长期存活的终端，tmux 托管多个 shell，人可随时接手，所有操作留痕可审计。

description.en: Floating work dashboard HUD plugin for DeepSeek Harness: session speed, token totals, DeepSeek balance, and per-model cost estimates.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面上悬浮显示会话速度、token 用量、账户余额和按模型估算的费用，随时掌握工作状态。

description.en: The first multi-user collaboration rooms for DeepSeek Harness: discuss, coordinate tasks, propose changes, and review work together from each participant's local DSH.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上多人协作房间，大家一起讨论、分工、提改动、互相评审。

description.en: Companion-AI hot/cold memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto dialogue archive, graduated cooling, cue-gated recall, 1600-token memory snapshot. ｜ 陪伴 AI 冷热分层记忆：全自动归档 + 渐进冷存 + 线索召回。
description.zh: 给陪伴 AI 加上冷热分层记忆，自动归档对话、渐进冷存、按线索召回，省 token 不忘事。

description.en: Composer UI for DeepSeek Harness that does two things. The reasoning-effort row in the model menu becomes a continuous slider drawn on the row itself, with the rungs read live from the model adapter so any ladder length works; each rung paints its own ember plume into a canvas behind the knob. Separately, the permission trigger renders in the theme error colour whenever full access is the active preset, including its row in the permission menu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的输入框增强，做两件事。模型菜单里的推理等级行变成直接画在该行上的连续滑块，档位实时读取模型适配器，因此档位数不限；每档会在旋钮背后的 canvas 上喷出各自的余烬尾焰。另外，只要当前是完全权限，权限触发器就用主题的错误色渲染，权限菜单里对应那一行同样变红。

description.en: Adds a gear button beside the sidebar account row that opens the Settings panel in one click. It runs the host's own settings.open command, so it reaches the shell store directly instead of going through the account menu, and the behaviour is identical on desktop and on a phone over the LAN where no keyboard shortcut is available.
description.zh: 在侧边栏账号行右侧添加一个齿轮按钮，点击一次即打开设置面板。它调用宿主自带的 settings.open 命令直达 shell 状态，不经过账号菜单；桌面端与手机局域网访问行为一致，后者没有键盘快捷键可用。

description.en: A starter plugin to copy from: one right-sidebar tab with two languages, behaviour tests that mount the real bundle, and CI that runs the manifest preflight.
description.zh: 可直接照抄的入门插件：一个右侧栏标签页、中英两份文案、挂载真实 bundle 的行为测试，以及会跑清单预检的 CI。

description.en: Image understanding for DSH: describe an image and read the text in it through Zhipu GLM-4V (needs a Zhipu API key, free tier), with optional person identification through Volcengine Ark and anime-only reverse image search through SauceNAO or trace.moe (each needs its own key); ffmpeg must be installed for GIF/WebP input. Keys and the ffmpeg path are set on the plugin's own settings page.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加识图：用智谱 GLM-4V 描述图片、读图中文字（需智谱 API Key，有免费额度），可选火山方舟认人、SauceNAO / trace.moe 反查动漫原图（各需自己的 Key）；GIF/WebP 图需要装 ffmpeg。Key 与 ffmpeg 路径在插件自带的设置页里配。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: extracts durable facts from sessions in the background, recalls relevant memories on demand, and keeps a layered summary, a persona snapshot and a commitment ledger; data stays local unless you point it at your own private Git repository.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话记忆：后台从会话中抽取耐久事实，按需召回相关记忆，维护分层摘要、persona 快照与承诺台账；数据默认留在本机，可选同步到自己的私有 Git 仓库。

description.en: Session operations for DeepSeek Harness: really delete persisted sessions (ungrouped, temp, archive and subagent filters; guards on running, live and workspace sessions) and move sessions between workspaces (log relocation, header.cwd rewrite, workspace registry follow). Ships the shared session-store library.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话运维：真正删除持久化会话（未分组、临时、归档、子代理四种筛选；运行中、仍在宿主加载中与属于工作区的会话默认拒绝删除），并在工作区之间搬迁会话（日志迁移、header.cwd 改写、workspace 注册表跟随）。内含共享的会话存储库。

description.en: Delegates independent tasks from DeepSeek Harness to the local OpenAI Codex CLI and returns the result to the current conversation. Provides four tools (task execution, status check, danger-mode toggle, enable/disable switch), enforces a real-path working-directory whitelist with symlink-escape protection, defaults to Codex workspace-write sandbox mode, passes the task body as a single argv argument to avoid shell injection, kills the whole Codex process group on timeout or cancel, and caps output length. Requires Node.js >= 20 and a Codex CLI build supporting codex exec.
description.zh: 把独立任务从 DeepSeek Harness 委派给本机 OpenAI Codex CLI 执行，并把结果返回当前会话。提供四个工具（任务执行、状态检查、危险模式开关、启停开关），强制真实路径白名单并做软链逃逸防护，默认使用 Codex workspace-write 沙箱模式，任务正文以单个 argv 参数传递避免 shell 注入，超时或取消时终止完整 Codex 进程组，并限制输出长度。需要 Node.js >= 20 和支持 codex exec 的 Codex CLI。

description.en: Inserts the full path as text when a folder is pasted into the input box, instead of trying to upload it (Windows and macOS).
description.zh: 粘贴复制来的文件夹时插入完整路径文本，而不是尝试上传（支持 Windows 与 macOS）。

description.en: Agent preset that hands every task to a Claude Code subagent, so the session only writes the task brief, delegates and reports the result. Requires a locally installed, logged-in Claude Code.
description.zh: 一个 Agent 预设：把每个任务都交给 Claude Code 子代理执行，会话只负责写任务说明、委派与汇报结果。需本机已安装并登录 Claude Code。

description.en: Remember the DeepSeek Harness desktop window position, size and maximized state, restoring it on next launch. The window logic lives in a standalone PowerShell script that does not depend on the client version; the plugin shell only installs it, keeps it autostarted and exposes a toggle.
description.zh: 记住 DSH 桌面窗口的位置、大小与最大化状态，下次启动回到上次离开的地方。窗口逻辑放在独立的 PowerShell 脚本里，不依赖客户端版本；插件外壳只负责安装、自启和开关。

description.en: Opens a folder in DeepSeek Harness from the OS: a Windows Explorer context-menu verb, a macOS Finder Quick Action and QSpace service, and the dsh-open launcher that starts or hands off to the desktop app. The OS menu entries need a one-time registration script (install-menu.ps1 on Windows, install-macos.sh on macOS) after installing the plugin.
description.zh: 从系统里用 DeepSeek Harness 打开文件夹：Windows 资源管理器右键动词、macOS Finder 快速操作与 QSpace 服务，以及负责启动或交接桌面端的 dsh-open 启动器。系统菜单需在安装插件后运行一次注册脚本（Windows 用 install-menu.ps1，macOS 用 install-macos.sh）才会出现。

description.en: Zhinao (second brain) for DeepSeek Harness: Markdown-authoritative layered memory (L1 long-term model gated by user confirmation / L2 knowledge with mandatory sources / L3 recent status under daily quotas), a local recall ledger explaining every injection, lifecycle engine with weekly review and a Web panel. First-run wizard initializes a blank brain, adopts an existing Zhinao directory read-only, or fills in only missing skeleton files; existing files are never touched.
description.zh: 智脑（第二大脑）—— DeepSeek Harness 的 Markdown 权威记忆插件：分层记忆（L1 长期模型经用户确认 / L2 知识必须留源 / L3 近况每日配额），本地召回账本可解释每次注入，生命周期引擎带周回顾与 Web 面板。首次运行向导支持空白脑新建、只读接管现有智脑目录、或仅补齐缺失骨架文件，均不改动已有文件。

description.en: Always-on-top status pill for DSH on Windows: shows each session's turn state (thinking with a running timer, waiting for approval, done, failed) above every window, collapses to a small dot while thinking continues and disappears a few seconds after a turn finishes, stacks up to three concurrent sessions side by side with a +N overflow badge, and hides itself while a fullscreen app is in front. Clicking it brings DSH to the foreground and dragging moves it; it reuses the Electron build already shipped with DSH Desktop, so nothing extra is downloaded. A settings card on the plugin page adjusts scale, mini size, position, hold times, effects and per-state visibility.
description.zh: Windows 上的 DSH 置顶状态胶囊：把每个会话的回合状态（思考并计时、等待审批、完成、失败）浮在所有窗口之上，思考持续时缩成小圆点，回合结束后几秒内消失，最多并排显示三个会话、其余折成 +N 角标，前台是全屏应用时自动隐藏。点击可把 DSH 拉到前台，拖动可改位置；复用 DSH Desktop 自带的 Electron，不额外下载。插件页里的设置卡片可调缩放、迷你尺寸、位置、收起时间、动效和各状态开关。

description.en: Per-person affinity for DSH personas on a QQ channel (a QQ bridge such as dsh-onebot-qq is required — the person is identified by the QQ number in each message; on the plain web UI nothing is injected): per-user scores with daily decay, reasons history, sulking and forgiveness, plus a global mood that colors replies.
description.zh: 在 QQ 通道上给 DSH 人设按人记好感度（需先装 QQ 通道插件，如 dsh-onebot-qq；身份取自消息里的 QQ 号，纯 Web 界面下不会注入）：分数、每日衰减、理由回看、生闷气与哄好，外加影响整体语气的综合情绪。

description.en: Control a local Linux desktop from DeepSeek Harness with 19 tools: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, scroll, window, application, display and state-verification control over a native X11 session with XTEST, plus optional AT-SPI accessibility-tree reads and widget value setting. Not for Wayland. Requires xdotool on the host (XTEST input); screenshots and window control also want scrot, ffmpeg, wmctrl, xrandr and xprop, and the AT-SPI tools need python3-gi, at-spi2-core and libatk-adaptor. Missing packages can be installed from the plugin's dependency panel with sudo.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控本机 Linux 桌面，提供 19 个工具：截图、鼠标、键盘、滚动、窗口、应用、显示器与状态校验，基于原生 X11 + XTEST 会话，并可选读取 AT-SPI 无障碍树与直接给控件赋值，不适用于 Wayland。需要宿主安装 xdotool（XTEST 注入）；截图与窗口控制还需 scrot、ffmpeg、wmctrl、xrandr、xprop，AT-SPI 工具另需 python3-gi、at-spi2-core、libatk-adaptor。缺失的软件包可在插件详情页的依赖面板用 sudo 一键补装。

description.en: Free LaTeX formula editor in the DSH sidebar with offline MathJax/PDF.js rendering: ten symbol tiles with hover palettes, ten template groups, live preview, colour/font/size/environment controls, favourites with titles and search, and nine export formats (SVG/PNG/JPG, LaTeX/AsciiMath/Typst/HTML/MathML/OMML) with escaping and share links. Image and PDF OCR need a vision-capable model in DSH or your own OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint; everything else runs offline.
description.zh: 免费的 DSH 侧栏 LaTeX 公式编辑器，MathJax/PDF.js 渲染全部离线：10 个符号磁贴悬停展开分类面板、10 组公式模板、实时预览、颜色/字体/字号/环境控制、带标题与搜索的收藏夹，以及九种导出格式（SVG/PNG/JPG、LaTeX/AsciiMath/Typst/HTML/MathML/OMML）与转义和分享链接。图片与 PDF 识别需要 DSH 中可用的视觉模型，或你自己配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点；其余功能全部离线运行。

description.en: Shrinks oversized bash and job_output text by piping it through the external rtk binary, keeps the original in a spill file and lets the model fetch it back on demand; keeps the original text when rtk is missing or fails.
description.zh: 把超大 bash / job_output 文本交给外部 rtk 二进制压缩，原文写入 spill 文件供模型按需取回；rtk 缺失或失败时保留原文。

description.en: Adds a right-click command "通过 dsh 打开" (open with dsh) to the Windows Explorer right-click menu for a folder, a folder's empty background and any file: it launches DeepSeek Harness on that folder, creates a new session every time, and puts the clicked file into the new draft as an @ reference. Ships a packaged-COM menu for the Windows 11 modern menu plus a registry entry for the classic menu; first install asks once for a certificate trust (native/trust-cert.bat).
description.zh: 给 Windows 资源管理器右键菜单加「通过 dsh 打开」：文件夹、文件夹空白处、任意文件都能用。点击后在对应文件夹启动 DeepSeek Harness 并新建会话；文件右键会把这个文件以 @ 引用预置进新会话草稿。Win11 新式菜单用打包 COM 组件，经典菜单 用注册表项；首次安装需要点一次证书受信（native/trust-cert.bat）。

description.en: Layered context management: at each turn end older tool output becomes a deterministic card, the model can fold older ranges into its own summaries in up to three tiers (compress), and every original is archived locally for decompress and search_context. Works alongside DSH-Mem0: superseded runtime-context snapshots (such as recalled memories) are never archived, carded or folded, and are replaced by a one-line placeholder at turn end when the prompt cache is already broken, when the saving outweighs the cache miss, or above 75% of the window; a strataBudget service (pressure, allowance, countTokens) and a strata/fold-landed event are provided for other context plugins; strata_status warns when DSH's automatic compaction is off or its official summary keeps failing. Its L1 layer, archive rotation, prune guard and preset takeover are forked from dsh-live-compact 1.0.6 (MIT); uninstall dsh-live-compact or billion-context first — they replace the same compaction rows and Strata will not take over while either is installed.
description.zh: 分层上下文管理：每轮结束时把较早的工具输出替换成确定性卡片；模型可以用 compress 把较早的范围折叠成自己写的摘要，最多三级；所有原文都存在本地，可用 decompress 和 search_context 取回。可与 DSH-Mem0 同时使用：过期的运行时上下文快照（比如召回的记忆）不存档、不切卡、不折叠；在前缀缓存已经失效、清理的收益超过缓存损失，或上下文超过窗口 75% 时，于轮末换成一行占位；为其他上下文插件提供 strataBudget 服务（pressure、allowance、countTokens）和 strata/fold-landed 事件；DSH 自动压缩没有启用、或官方摘要连续失败时，strata_status 会给出警告。其 L1 层、存档轮换、裁剪保护与预设接管分叉自 dsh-live-compact 1.0.6（MIT）；请先卸载 dsh-live-compact 或 billion-context——它们替换同一行压缩配置，装着任一者时 Strata 不会接管。

description.en: Adds two-level tabs (provider and model family) to the composer model picker for large catalogs, with configurable family rules.
description.zh: 给 composer 模型选择器加两级 Tab（提供商 + 模型系列），大目录时减少滚动翻找；族规则可在设置页配置。

description.en: Adds a clarify mode: the agent loses its file-writing tools and can only ask questions until the required dimensions are covered, then writes a spec with acceptance criteria before implementing.
description.zh: 加一个需求澄清模式：模式内移除写文件工具，Agent 只能提问，覆盖完必需维度后产出带验收标准的 spec，再开始实现。

description.en: Adds a reasoning-effort rail above the DSH composer: drag or use the keyboard to preview and submit the levels the current model exposes (Off through Max), while a procedurally rendered micro-universe contracts and collapses into a black hole as effort rises. Levels go through the DSH model-selection interface, so the rail shows the level DSH confirms, and the plugin writes only to $DSH_HOME/stellar-effort/.
description.zh: 在输入框上方加一条推理强度滑轨：拖动或用键盘预览并提交当前模型支持的档位（Off 到 Max），滑轨背后由程序实时渲染的微缩宇宙随档位收缩、坍缩成黑洞。档位通过 DSH 自身的模型选择接口提交，显示的是 DSH 确认后的等级；插件只写入 $DSH_HOME/stellar-effort/。

description.en: Compare two or three answers in one session and drop chosen turns from every later model request.
description.zh: 在同一会话里对比两三次回答，并从之后每次模型请求中剔除指定的轮次。

description.en: Bridges the shared ~/.agentloom store between DeepSeek Harness and Codex: injects the shared memories and the AGENTS.md entries the context budget truncates into the system prompt, and adds six loom_* tools for status, sync, memory search/list/add and skill listing. Requires the agentloom CLI installed and a one-time agentloom init; the seven-tool MCP bridge in the same repo is a separate package for MCP clients.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 与 Codex 接到共享的 ~/.agentloom：将共享记忆与被上下文预算截断的 AGENTS.md 条目注入系统提示，并提供 status、sync、记忆检索/列出/写入与技能列出的六个 loom_* 工具。需先安装 agentloom CLI 并执行一次 agentloom init；同仓库的七工具 MCP 桥是另一个包，供 MCP 客户端使用。

description.en: Per-session fast-delivery mode from the composer. New conversations start enabled; switching is refused while that conversation is running, and a read-only session-header badge shows on/off during a run. One switch drives three subsystems: a circuit breaker that short-circuits test and build commands instead of running them, an apply_patch tool that writes SEARCH/REPLACE hunks atomically (all anchors must match or nothing is written), and a dehydrator that trims terminal output to a pass line or the last 15 error lines.
description.zh: 按会话独立的极速交付模式，从输入框切换。新对话默认开启；对话运行期间拒绝切换，并在会话头部显示只读开/关徽标。一个开关驱动三个子系统：测试与构建命令断路器（不真正执行，直接返回成功回执）、按 SEARCH/REPLACE 冲突块原子写入的 apply_patch 工具（任一锚点未命中则整次回滚）、以及把终端输出脱水成一句通过或最后 15 行错误的脱水器。

description.en: Hold Space to record and release to transcribe and send, without focusing the composer first. Esc cancels and window blur auto-cancels. Requires the official voice-input bundle (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`) enabled with its speech model downloaded; otherwise Space is left alone.
description.zh: 按住空格录音、松手自动识别并发送，不用先点输入框。按 Esc 可取消，切换窗口自动取消。需先启用官方「语音输入」Bundle（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`）并下载好语音模型，否则插件不接管空格。

description.en: Adds ChatGPT sign-in, Codex subscription quota (5-hour and weekly windows) and Codex-backed web search to DeepSeek Harness; installing it switches the profile's web search provider to openai-codex.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 ChatGPT 登录、Codex 订阅额度（5 小时与每周窗口）以及由 Codex 驱动的网页搜索；安装后整个 profile 的网页搜索会切到 openai-codex。

description.en: Persistent named AI teammates that watch your sources, wake only when there is a reason, decide their own next check, and bring you questions, approvals and alerts in chat threads.
description.zh: 常驻有名字的机器人队友：替你盯着信息源，有理由才唤醒思考，自己约下次自查，提问、审批与告警以卡片出现在对话线程里。

description.en: Sidebar schedule assistant for dsh-better-sidebar (that plugin is required — the tab is registered through it): multi-city weather, Chinese almanac, lunar calendar, schedules and reminders, todos, daily and weekly reports, zodiac horoscope, check-in buffs, and per-person rest-day work schedules.
description.zh: 给 dsh-better-sidebar 用的侧边栏日程助手（必须先装该插件，标签页由它注册）：多城市天气、黄历、农历日历、日程提醒、待办、日报周报、星座运势、好运签到，以及按人设置的休息日班制。

description.en: A private WeRead study in the DSH sidebar: the shelf folds into ten categories, highlights and thoughts page through and copy per item, and a reading heatmap plus KPI dashboard switch by year. Search covers shelf, books, highlights and thoughts. Talks to WeRead through the official agent gateway with your own API key and keeps everything in local JSON. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 把微信读书搬进 DSH 侧栏的私人书房：书架折叠成 10 大类，划线与想法可分页、可逐条复制，阅读热力图与统计表盘能按年份切换；书架、书籍、划线、想法都能搜索。通过官方 agent 网关用你自己的 API Key 读取数据，全部落在本机 JSON。要求 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Usage statistics inside Settings: a GitHub-style one-year conversation heatmap of your own daily messages, token usage totals by model and by day/week/month with stat cards, and a per-day list of files written or edited via write/edit tools. All computed locally from session history with incremental rescans; no data leaves the machine.
description.zh: 设置面板内的使用统计：GitHub 风格一年对话热力图（按每天本人消息数着色，自动排除子代理与注入上下文）、按模型与按天/周/月汇总的 Token 用量（统计卡片 + 表格）、以及每天通过 write/edit 工具产出或修改的文件清单（日期选择）。全部本地扫描会话历史完成、增量更新，数据不出本机。

description.en: Traces how something became what it is, what it currently rests on, and what it will become next.
description.zh: 回望一件事怎么变成现在这样，说清它现在靠什么成立，判断它下一步会变成什么。

description.en: Names sessions as a category plus a short topic. A sidebar action reads the conversation, asks its model for the pair, and pre-fills an editable title; a smart_rename_session tool gives the same naming to the agent, which renames the session it runs in when the topic moves on.
description.zh: 把会话命名成「分类 · 主题」：侧边栏菜单读对话、让会话所用的模型给出分类与主题并预填可编辑的标题；另有一个 smart_rename_session 工具，让 agent 在话题切换时自己改名。

description.en: Local-first task workbench for DeepSeek Harness with today, week and all-task views, single-day and multi-day tasks with optional times, a four-state idea pool, and daily/weekly/monthly reviews that only a human can write.
description.zh: 本地优先的任务工作台：今日/本周/任务总表、当天与跨周期任务（可选时间）、四态想法池，以及日/周/月复盘；复盘正文只能人写，AI 只读。

description.en: A dedicated background-job dashboard for the DSH Web UI: merges jobs from every session, shows producer-reported or parsed progress with an honest estimate fallback, groups by status, purpose, session or kind, streams live output, and keeps a local history ledger.
description.zh: 跨会话的后台任务面板：进度按「任务自报 / 输出解析 / 历史耗时估算」三档显示，可按状态、用途、会话或类型分组，支持实时输出、输出内搜索与本地历史台账。
在侧栏直接删会话，还能在设置里统一调字号和分区配色，纯前端零依赖。

description.en: Import local AI-assistant histories (Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, Cursor, Trae) into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, plus a Web panel to preview and file them.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 AI 助手的聊天记录导入 DSH，变成能接着聊的会话，还能在网页面板里预览归档。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 AnySearch 搜索/抓取，并在插件页内置 API Key 设置卡片，留空即使用匿名额度。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上 AnySearch 搜索和网页抓取，插件页里直接填 API Key，不填也能用匿名额度。

description.en: 此刻 · 任务排程 — DSH 本地任务排程与到点提醒
description.zh: 按实时时间把今天的任务排进上班时段，到点弹窗提醒，还能看未来 7 天安排。

description.en: 小红书虚拟商品违规风险检测工作台 — DeepSeek Harness 插件（版权 / 违禁词 / 小红书平台规则词库 + DeepSeek 复核）
description.zh: 上架前帮你查小红书虚拟商品的版权和违禁词风险，本地规则先筛一遍，再让 DeepSeek 看图读文档复核，给出风险分级和改写建议。

description.en: Unofficial graphical panel for the local Mole CLI on macOS: live system health, cleanup previews with explicit confirmation, disk analysis, app inventory, maintenance, cleanup history, and a guided Homebrew install of the CLI.
description.zh: 非官方 Mole CLI 图形面板（macOS）：实时系统状态、清理预览与二次确认、磁盘分析、应用清单、系统维护、清理历史，并内置 Homebrew 安装引导。

description.en: A slim live DeepSeek account-balance bar for the DeepSeek Harness Web shell.
description.zh: 在 Web 界面底部常驻显示 DeepSeek 账户余额和赠送额度，每 15 秒自动刷新，随时掌握花费情况。

description.en: 3D model viewer for DeepSeek Harness: STEP / STL / GLB / GLTF
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏直接打开并旋转查看 STEP、STL、GLB、GLTF 三维模型，聊到模型不用切窗口转格式。

description.en: dsh-a-stock-analysis · A股投资研究 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件：A股投资研究方法论——四大视角（市场分析/财务分析/市场情绪/投资策略）+ AKShare 数据工具指引 + Agent 配置参考。纯技能零 API key。A-stock research dsh plugin: 4-perspective methodology + AKShare guide
description.zh: 给 A 股投资研究搭好四大视角方法论和 AKShare 数据指引，不用 API key 就能上手分析。

description.en: Real DeepSeek account balance and real token usage/spend by day, week, month, quarter, or year, in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏直接查看 DeepSeek 账号余额，并按日周月季年统计真实 Token 用量和消费金额。

description.en: A folder-free left sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: live agents with provider mark, status, directory and work in flight.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个左侧边栏，每个活跃智能体一行，显示来源、状态、目录和手头任务。

description.en: 为 dsh 的智能体团队的任务/成员开发的可视化管理插件
description.zh: 在右侧栏直接查看和管理智能体团队的成员与任务，让团队协作一目了然。

description.en: dsh-amazon-skills · 亚马逊卖家工具箱 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件：54 个亚马逊运营技能随包分发（选品调研、Listing 优化、FBA 计算、PPC 广告、评论策略、关税计算……），外加两个真实数据工具（关键词长尾扩展、商品页结构化抓取）与一个侧栏工作台面板。Amazon seller toolkit dsh plugin: 54 skills + keyword expander + listing scraper
description.zh: 亚马逊卖家工具箱，内置54个运营技能和真实数据工具，选品、Listing、广告一站搞定。

description.en: Anime character avatars and per-provider thinking styles for the DSH model picker.
description.zh: 给 DSH 模型选择器加上二次元角色头像，思考时换成对应系列的图标动画和文案，装好即用。

description.en: Answer me with HTML for DeepSeek Harness: native tool + skill + tool card, renders one-page HTML answers and opens them in the Document Preview (Web & Desktop).
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 用单页 HTML 回答你，并在文档预览里直接打开查看。
把蚂蚁桌宠搬进 DSH，陪你写代码、解闷互动，让开发过程更有趣。

description.en: 专为 DSH iOS App 与多终端协同打造：多设备同时在线无缝切换、实时同屏收发、锁屏秒级自愈（Fast-Resume），支持局域网 3082/3083 隔离与三层通用稳定外网通道。
description.zh: 让 DSH 在电脑、iPhone、iPad 间无缝切换，实时同屏收发，锁屏回来秒级恢复连接。

description.en: Multi-platform API keys for DeepSeek Harness: store keys for GitHub, Cloudflare, Vercel, npm, Docker Hub, Hugging Face and your own platforms, and let the model call their APIs as you via apikey_call / apikey_platforms / apikey_key.
description.zh: 把 GitHub、Cloudflare、Vercel 等平台的 API 密钥集中存好，模型就能直接调用这些接口。

description.en: DSH 审批审计：把审批与工具调用写成本地 JSONL，并把会话切到完全权限预设（等于关闭审批闸门，慎用）· Approval & tool-call audit for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把审批和工具调用记成本地 JSONL 日志，同时强制会话切到完全权限，方便事后审计但风险很高。

description.en: Development preview: isolated DSH memory/planning experiments with external judging and budget controls. Paid experiments held.
description.zh: 在同一批编程任务上对比不同 DeepSeek 智能体架构，支持外部评审和预算控制，方便做受控实验。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 归档会话管理插件，支持按工作区检索、恢复和删除会话。
description.zh: 在设置里集中查看、恢复和删除归档会话，还能按工作区快速检索，找回过期对话很方便。

description.en: 让 dsh 能够连接你的 aria2 RPC 接口，提供下载任务的创建、查询、暂停、恢复和取消功能。不自带 aria2，不对 aria2 进程进行管理（假定你已经部署了持久化的 aria2 后台服务，不应由dsh插手）
description.zh: 让 dsh 连上你已有的 aria2 服务，直接创建、查询、暂停、恢复和取消下载任务。

description.en: Computer use plugin for DSH/AryaCode: agent-desktop UIA engine + agent-browser web lane + takeover UI, replacing dsh-computer-use-win
description.zh: 让 AI 直接操作 Windows 桌面应用，靠系统无障碍接口精准点击，还能随时接管操作。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的旁问卡片：问你不会的专业术语，答案不进主对话

description.en: Ship OpenTelemetry GenAI observability and multi-device cloud state sync from one DSH bundle. It reuses and replaces the standalone @loongsuite/dsh-plugin (traces + metrics for sessions, agent loop, LLM and tool lifecycle; do not install both — disable or remove the upstream plugin first), and adds a WebSocket client that pushes full session event logs (header + snapshotEvents) to a relay you run so different local DSH instances share state. On connect it pulls and rebuilds the other devices' sessions automatically (cross-device resume). The sync client itself has zero third-party runtime dependencies; a small Node.js relay is included in the repo. The local /cloud-sync/* HTTP routes (status, sessions, config, resync, delete) have no origin or loopback check, and the bundled relay accepts unauthenticated connections unless AUTH_TOKEN is set — keep the DSH web port off untrusted networks and run the relay with a token.
description.zh: 一个 DSH bundle 同时提供 OpenTelemetry GenAI 可观测性与多设备云端状态同步：复用并替换独立的 @loongsuite/dsh-plugin（为会话、Agent 循环、LLM 与工具生命周期产出 trace/metric；不要与上游同装，先禁用或移除它），并新增 WebSocket 客户端把完整会话事件日志（header + snapshotEvents）推送到自建中继，让不同本地端的 DSH 状态互通；连接时自动拉回并重建其他设备的会话（跨设备续接）。同步客户端本体零第三方运行时依赖；仓库内附带一个小型 Node.js 中继。本机的 `/cloud-sync/*` HTTP 路由（status、sessions、config、resync、delete）没有同源/回环校验，随包中继在未设置 AUTH_TOKEN 时不鉴权——请勿把 DSH Web 端口暴露到不受信任的网络，并给中继配置 token。
